d:
Bangladesh is witnessing fresh political violence, with bomb blasts, arson attacks and killings reported across several districts. Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has accused Sheikh Hasina and her supporters of conspiring to destabilise the country, indirectly pointing towards India. His remarks come amid Hasina's announcement that she plans to return to Bangladesh in December. Why is Rahman targeting Hasina and indirectly criticising India? What is behind the renewed unrest?
Production: Akash Singh
Video Editor: Danish
